property_summary: After the owner calls NETM(), the owner's own balance must equal totalDistributed (so any transfer of up to totalDistributed to an arbitrary recipient succeeds and credits the recipient); the mutant credits address(0) instead, leaving the owner with zero balance so such transfers fail.
change_summary: Set owner to address(0) in NETM so the distributed balance is written to balances[address(0)] instead of the caller's balance.
